skill_name: Generate a possible use case for a home security system.
workflow: A home security system can be used to deter intruders and detect any security breaches. When an intruder is detected, an alarm will sound, alerting the homeowner and deterring the intruder. Security cameras can be used to monitor the premises for any movement and alert the homeowner if any suspicious activity is detected.
